written: 2026-10-20, before stage-2 embedding and before any amended model is trained

author_decisions_2026-10-20.stage2_fetch: BIA bucket only, native pycurl fetcher (the IDR bucket holds one MitoCheck plate, LT0001_02; section 7's two-bucket split is not possible)
author_decisions_2026-10-20.shuffled_control: trained shuffled-encoding models: per source, 3 seeds trained on a fixed random permutation of genes to encodings (permutation seed = model seed); G-ZeroShot-2 compares true-encoding models with these. The stage-1 evaluation-time shuffle is also reported (secondary).
author_decisions_2026-10-20.grid_scope: every gated model family selects its own configuration from the 8-config grid on validation, by the mean over 3 seeds: H1 action-conditioned, H1 action-agnostic, each H2 source (true) and each H2 source (trained shuffled)
author_decisions_2026-10-20.h1_action_conditioned: learned per-gene embedding (with reagent token), as in stage 1

fixed_not_tuned.schedule: OneCycle over max_steps (anneals fully at max_steps)
fixed_not_tuned.early_stopping: keep the checkpoint with the lowest validation primary error; stop when it has not improved for 3000 steps
fixed_not_tuned.note: rollout 6 is the stage-1 validation selection (config B); other values as in stage 1

validation_primary_error.H1: MSE in the per-plate control-normalised space at 24 h and 36 h (clips 8 and 12, mean of the two) on primary wells (splits/amend02_h1_primary_wells.tsv) on validation plates
validation_primary_error.H2: same horizons on wells of primary genes (splits/amend02_h2_primary_genes.tsv) in the validation gene split, on training or validation plates

normalisation: section 1: per plate p, clip t, dimension d, mean and SD over the plate's negative-control wells of the tile-mean latent; sigma floored at the 5th percentile of sigma over all plates and clips for that d; plates with < 4 usable negative-control wells dropped and listed
seed_averaging: per well and horizon, the errors of the three seeds' predictions are averaged before the plate- or gene-level test (section 4)

fixed_before_any_amended_model_2026-10-2.selection: per family, the grid configuration with the lowest mean over seeds of the best validation primary error; written to results/a2/selection.json and committed before any gate is computed
fixed_before_any_amended_model_2026-10-2.h2_action_agnostic_reference: the selected h1_none models (3 seeds), evaluated on the H2 wells
fixed_before_any_amended_model_2026-10-2.planning_source: the G-ZeroShot-2-passing source with the most negative mean (true - trained-shuffled) primary error on validation; if none passes, the source with the most negative mean, and H3 is exploratory

secondary_analyses.global_preprocessing: every family re-trained on the globally standardised latents with its selected configuration, 3 seeds (no grid); reported beside the normalised results
secondary_analyses.alternative_backbones: DINOv2 and TiJepa-1: h1_learned and h1_none with the V-JEPA 2 selected configurations, 3 seeds, per-plate normalisation
secondary_analyses.complex_split: planning source true and trained-shuffled, and h1_none, on the complex-held-out split with selected configurations, 3 seeds

planning_horizons.trajectory_score: mean squared distance at clips 8 and 12 (24 h, 36 h) to the target well's observed latents
planning_horizons.phenotype_target: primary clip 12 (36 h), secondary clip 8 (24 h); start = negative-control clip-0 tile tokens of 20 seeded training plates

fixed_before_any_amended_model_2026-10-2.replicate_baselines: fallback order for a well of siRNA s, gene g: s's training-plate wells; else g's other siRNAs' training-plate wells; else the plate's negative-control drift (replicate drift) / the training-wide clip mean (replicate endpoint); the fallback used is counted; replicate changes and endpoints are averaged over the replicate wells and their four tiles (tile positions are exchangeable fields of view) and added to / broadcast over every tile of the evaluated well, as for the control- and slot-drift baselines; the same applies to the nearest-gene lookup
fixed_before_any_amended_model_2026-10-2.phenotype_probe: logistic regression (C = 0.1, balanced) trained on observed clip-12 latents of training-plate library wells; applied to observed and forecast clip-12 latents of all library wells on evaluated plates; seed-averaged decision scores; AUROC 95% cluster-bootstrap CI over plates (2,000 resamples)

author_decisions_2026-10-21.screenB: evaluated after the freeze under the global preprocessing only, outside the gates, as a secondary independent-reagent test: H1 (seen genes; primary wells = splits/amend02_screenB_primary_wells.tsv, gene-level reproducible terms on screenA training plates) and H2 (test-split genes); every method and baseline in the global space with the global-preprocessing models (selected configurations, 3 seeds); siRNA token masked for screenB siRNAs; reported next to the global test results. Plate-control baselines are not available on screenB (no negative controls).
author_decisions_2026-10-21.plate_probe: section 1 unchanged for the gates; diagnostics added for global, control-normalised and centre-only versions: (a) within-series replicate probe, (b) negative-control-only probe with leave-one-out normalisation statistics
author_decisions_2026-10-21.report: RUN_REPORT_STAGE2 lists the 20 frozen primary test wells outside the test layout (LT0008_17: 17, LT0155_08: 3; plates absent from the S-BIAD865 S3 conversion) and names the data used to choose tile-averaged replicate baselines

record_for_run_report.tile_averaged_replicate_baselines_choice: development check on 2026-10-20 before any real amended model: a throwaway cache of stage-1 latents only (data/latents, splits/stage1_wells.tsv; test plates excluded), per-plate control normalisation; development models (h1_learned and h1_none, config 22M_d0.1_w0.05, seeds 0-2, 250 steps, deleted afterwards); evaluation on the stage-1 validation plates' 104 primary wells on 13 plates (683 library wells). Replicate drift with tile-k-to-tile-k changes had primary 24/36 h error 7.62 vs copy-last 5.54; averaged over tiles 5.72. No test plate, test gene or stage-2 well was used.

primary_test_wells_outside_layout.reason: the two plates are absent from the S-BIAD865 OME-Zarr conversion on EBI S3 (not in manifests/s3_plate_map.json), so they could not enter the test layout

missing_frames_rule.registered: 2026-10-23, completion plan v2 step S3, before the freeze and before any test plate or screenB well is embedded
missing_frames_rule.rule: a well with any level-1 frame missing after 3 attempts (HTTP 404 re-requested with back-off; src/geneworld/io/s3fetch.py MAX_404_ATTEMPTS = 3) is excluded from every analysis, as in train and validation; no partial-movie embedding (F9: listed under 'not run')
missing_frames_rule.train_and_validation: unchanged: the wells embedded in stage 1 and stage 2 (missing-frame audit S2: results/a2/missing_frames.json); recovered frames are listed only
missing_frames_rule.records: the embed failure lists (logs/embed_failures_<tag>.json) are copied to results/a2/embed_failures_test.json and results/a2/embed_failures_screenB.json, committed and backed up with SHA-256 before any test or screenB evaluation

report.counts: for test and screenB separately: wells, plates (whole plates lost listed), primary wells (H1: splits/amend02_h1_primary_wells.tsv; screenB: splits/amend02_screenB_primary_wells.tsv) and primary-gene wells (splits/amend02_h2_primary_genes.tsv) lost; wells lost whose missing frames are all >= 88 (F9)
report.independence_test: library wells only; phenotype class of a well = the classes its siRNA carries on training plates (screenA annotation rows on training plates; screenB: its gene's classes on screenA training plates, the gene-level rule of the screenB primary wells); for each of mitotic_delay, polylobed, binuclear and 'any reproducible class': two-sided Fisher exact test of lost vs embedded x class vs not; Benjamini-Hochberg over the 4 tests; reported for test and screenB separately
report.use: descriptive only: never used to change the exclusion, a gate, a metric or a model

clarifications.type: clarification of the H1 primary-well definition, not an amendment; recorded before the freeze
clarifications.text: H1 primary wells = frozen H1 primary wells (splits/amend02_h1_primary_wells.tsv) whose gene is in the training gene split (splits/gene_split.tsv), minus the missing-frame exclusions (S2 for validation, S3 for test). H1 asks whether the action-conditioned model forecasts seen genes on held-out plates (design A.4); wells of validation- and test-split genes belong to H2.
